subject: ClearLake — Secondary teams onboarding, API keys & renewal amendment
messages:
From: Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@clearlakehealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Expansion request — adding 5 more project teams

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the Q4 renewal conversation. We concluded internally that we want to bring five additional product teams onto Redwood next quarter — primarily for natural language search and triage workflows. High-level asks: 

- Separate API keys per project/team (security requirement)
- Per-key quotas and rate-limits (we expect spiky ingest from one project)
- A short amendment to extend committed capacity + an updated unit price for the additional consumption

Can you put together a recommended rollout plan (keys, naming convention, timeline) and a sketched cost addendum we can review with procurement? We’re aiming to have keys provisioned and a canary team active by Feb 1.

I can loop Tom (infra) if you want details on network/VPC configs.

Appreciate it —
Elaine
Elaine Morris
Director of Integrations | ClearLake Health
elaine.morris@clearlakehealth.com
+1 415 555 0192

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@clearlakehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 12:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Expansion request — adding 5 more project teams

Hi Elaine —

Thanks — this is great context. We can absolutely support per-project API keys + per-key quotas. High level proposal (summary below) and I attached a provisioning template + an initial SOW addendum for procurement to review.

Plan (summary):
- Naming: clearlake-<project>-env (e.g., clearlake-claims-canary)
- Keys: one key per project + one shared monitoring key for internal CS/ops
- Quotas: default soft limit 300 req/min per key, adjustable per key once we see traffic
- Canary: pick one non-critical team to activate by Feb 1; we’ll run a 2-week canary to validate latency and billing patterns
- Staged rollout: 1 canary (Feb 1), 2 pilots (Feb 14), full enable (Mar 1)
- Capacity/commits: recommend adding 250k committed tokens/month for the first quarter of expansion; price summary attached (price_summary_qt_v2.xlsx)

Next steps:
1) I’ll schedule a 30-minute technical kickoff with your infra lead and our SEs — can you confirm Tom’s availability?
2) Procurement: I’ll send the addendum to your procurement contact and load the DocuSign link — please review the SOW addendum attached.
3) We’ll provision test keys upon kickoff and deliver the CSV provisioning template.

I’ll follow up with a short internal note to Ben and Karthik to coordinate the provisioning runbook.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(priya_natarajan@redwood.com)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 06 Jan 2027 09:23:00 -0500
Subject: FW: ClearLake expansion — provisioning runbook (prep)

FYI — looping in the provisioning steps I’ll own. Priya, I’ll prepare the provisioning script and key naming enforcement in the console. Karthik, can you validate quota defaults and automation for per-key rate-limiting?

Provisioning checklist (draft):
- Receive completed API_Key_Provisioning_Template.csv from customer (columns: project_name, owner_name, env, required_quota, jabber_contact)
- Pre-create keys in staging, publish to secret manager (masked in console)
- Tag keys with team metadata and policy (SLA tier: enterprise)
- Seed prefix cache allocation for high-throughput projects
- Notify CS and client when keys are ready for validation

Attachments: API_Key_Provisioning_Template.csv referenced. I’ll drop the provisioning playbook in the shared Drive.

-b

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearlakehealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@clearlakehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Jan 2027 15:41:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Expansion request — adding 5 more project teams

Priya / Elaine —

Quick note from infra: the teams will be on separate VPCs but we will route outbound through a central NAT. We need TLS mutual auth for the monitoring endpoint and a static egress IP for allowlisting. Can Redwood support a static egress option for the dedicated pool?

Also, can you confirm keys can be rotated without downtime (we want to script rotation via our secrets manager)?

Thanks,
Tom
Senior Cloud Engineer | ClearLake Health

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearlakehealth.com>, Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@clearlakehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 11:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Expansion request — adding 5 more project teams

Tom — good questions. Short answers: 
- Static egress: yes, for customers on a Dedicated or Private plan we can reserve static egress IPs for a customer-controlled pool (requires an addendum to the Dedicated attachment). I’ve noted this in the SOW addendum.
- Key rotation: keys can be rotated without downtime using a dual-write rotation model; we’ll provide the rotation sequence and a sample script that integrates with common secret managers.

I’ll add a short section to the addendum about egress and rotation. Ben/Karthik, please make sure the provisioning checklist accounts for rotation sequencing and static-egress tagging.

Priya

From: Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@clearlakehealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearlakehealth.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 18:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: ClearLake — Secondary teams onboarding, API keys & renewal amendment

Priya —

We reviewed the SOW addendum and the pricing summary with procurement this morning. Procurement has two asks: 1) a one-quarter ramp discount for the additional committed tokens, and 2) explicit language about support response times during the canary window. They are OK to proceed once those are added.

Tom confirmed the egress/network constraints — please include the mutual TLS requirement and the static IP detail. Otherwise procurement asked for a short kickoff (this week) with your SE and our infra.

I approved the staging/canary timeline (Feb 1 canary). Once we have the DocuSign addendum with the two procurement items, we can execute quickly.

Action items captured: 
- Priya: add quarter-ramp discount + SLA clause to addendum and send DocuSign link
- Ben: finalize provisioning script and upload playbook to Drive
- Karthik: confirm per-key quota defaults and rotation docs
- Tom: confirm a list of egress IPs to allowlist during staging

Thanks all — Elaine
